timeout.description: Global timeout (seconds) for each probe response. Increase for high-latency or congested networks.

start_ttl.description: Initial TTL value to start the traceroute from. Usually 1.

max_ttl.description: Maximum TTL value to probe. Limits the hop count of the trace.

probes_per_hop.description: Number of probe packets sent per hop for averaging. Higher values improve reliability at cost of time.

use_icmp.description: Fallback to ICMP ECHO probes if UDP probes are blocked by firewalls.

verbose.description: Enable detailed logging of packet contents and timing for debugging.

targets.description: List of destination hosts to trace, each with optional ports and source IP.

hostname.description: Hostname or IP address of the target.

ports.description: List of destination ports to probe (e.g., [80, 443]). Leave empty to use DefaultPorts.

source_ip.description: Optional source IP address to bind outgoing probes (for multi-homed hosts).

default_ports.description: Ports used as fallback when a target entry omits Ports.

interface.description: Network interface name to bind source sockets (e.g., eth0). Leave blank for automatic selection.

rate_limit.description: Maximum packets per second per target. Set to 0 for no limit. Use to avoid overwhelming targets.
